How we know

NMTS’s weekly rides page (copyright 2026, with entries dated Sept 27 and Oct 2, 2026) lists the 4th Monday ‘Start the Week Rite Ride’ at 9:00 am from the NE corner of San Pedro and Candelaria, 20 miles at 13 mph, and calls it a beginner ride (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Helmets are required on all NMTS rides. E-bikes are welcome at the ride leader’s discretion. The club points newer riders to this ride.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 13 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NMTS Start the Week Rite Ride (4th Monday) group ride

NMTS Start the Week Rite Ride (4th Monday) is a road, social and e-bikes welcome group ride in Albuquerque, NM. It rolls fourth Monday of the month at 9:00 am from NE corner of San Pedro and Candelaria.

A monthly easy-pace ride of about 20 miles on bike trails and bike lanes, led by Tom Sullivan. It began as a birthday ride for the club treasurer in 2013. The club calls it a good beginner ride.
